mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline by 0.5% over the prior month, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 3.5% in the next month, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and a collapse in demand-driven jobless claims (RSAFS) indicates oversupply in the economy, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases while RSAFS decreases in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase while RSAFS decreases in the next month, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in supply (INDPRO decline) coupled with a surge in demand for housing starts (HOUST increase) signals tight supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases while HOUST increases in the next month
failure_condition: INDPRO does not decrease while HOUST increases in the next month, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, sustained high federal funds rates above 2.5% amplify risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain above 2.5% for the period, or 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in jobless claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1.5 million signals labor market stress, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 1.5M in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show a sustained upward trend over the horizon, or 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals strong overall demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases while HOUST increases in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not increase while HOUST increases in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).
